description:
Cast Fiend Hunter.
With Fiend Hunter's ETB trigger target Leonin Relic-Warder.
Leonin Relic-Warder levaes the battlefield returning Oblivion Ring to play.
Target Fiend Hunter with the Oblivion Ring trigger.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield.
Leonin Relic-Warder targets Oblivion Ring exiling it under Relic-Warder.
Repeat steps 2-6.
